title: DNA extraction from fish tissue
author: Hervé Rogissart
materials: Wizard SV 96 Genomic DNA Purification System

NanoDrop measurement: Use 2 µL of elution buffer (without DNA) as a blank to calibrate the NanoDrop and correct for background absorbance To validate the blank, add 2 µL of elution buffer onto the NanoDrop pedestal and measure NanoDrop™ One UV-Vis Spectrophotometer (spectrophotometer, Thermo Scientific, ND-ONE-W, Sample Volume (Metric): Minimum 1µL; Spectral Bandwidth: ≤1.8 nm (FWHM at Hg 254 nm); System Requirements: Windows™ 8.1 and 10, 64 bit; Voltage: 12 V (DC); Wavelength Range: 190–850 nm, https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/ND-ONE-W ) To measure DNA concentration of sample, add 2 µL of sample DNA onto the NanoDrop pedestal and measure - Note down the A260/280, A260/230 and concentration (ng/μl) - or export the data to a USB storage device - Clean the surface between each read

Qubit Measurement: Ensure the Qubit is calibrated before starting Invitrogen™ Qubit™ 3 Fluorometer (Accurately measures DNA, RNA, and protein using the highly sensitive fluorescence-based Qubit quantitation assays, Invitrogen™ Q33216, Q33216, https://www.fishersci.co.uk/shop/products/qubit-3-0-fluorometer/15387293 ) Use the Qubit™ dsDNA BR Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32853 - Analyze 1 µL of extracted DNA - Note the concentration (ng/μl)

steps.title: Prepare tissue samples and tools
steps.instruction: Organize samples according to the plate map, decontaminate cutting tools by cleaning with DNA ExitusPlus, rinsing with water and covering with ethanol, then sterilize with a Bunsen burner; cut approximately 10–15 mg of fish tissue, place the tissue in a dedicated well of a 96‑Well Deep‑Well Plate, decontaminate or replace the cutting tools for each sample to avoid cross‑contamination, optionally cut tissue into smaller pieces to improve lysis efficiency, and store the plate at +4 °C for quick use (time stamp 08:00:00).

steps.title: Prepare lysis mixture and incubate
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysis mixture per sample by homogenizing the Digestion Solution Master Mix; when making mix for multiple samples, add extra volume equivalent to 1–1.5 additional samples for every 8 samples; add 275 mL lysis mixture to each well of the 96‑Well Deep‑Well Plate, cover the plate with an adhesive plate sealer and place a sheet of aluminum foil on top, then incubate at 55 °C for at least 18:00:00 in a pre‑heated stove (if the incubator is not pre‑heated, increase the incubation time). Overnight incubation ensures complete digestion.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and bind DNA
steps.instruction: After incubation, dispense 250 µL of Wizard SV Lysis Buffer into each well containing lysate while the lysate is still warm, and mix each well by pipetting up and down three times; set up the Vacuum Manifold by placing the Binding Plate in the Vacuum Manifold Base, orienting the plate with column headers toward the vacuum port, attaching the vacuum line, and transferring the tissue lysates to the Binding Plate wells; apply vacuum (≈508 mBar or 50.8 kPa) until all lysate has passed through, using a liquid trap (e.g., vacuum flask) to protect the pump, and keep the plate covered with the adhesive sealer to maintain strong vacuum.

steps.title: Wash binding matrix
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL of Column Wash Solution (CWA) to each well of the Binding Plate and apply vacuum until the solution passes through; repeat this wash two more times for a total of three CWA washes; after the wells are empty, continue vacuum for an additional 00:06:00 to dry the binding matrix; turn off the vacuum, release the vacuum line and snap it into the vacuum port on the Vacuum Manifold Collar, remove the Binding Plate, and blot it gently on a clean paper towel to remove residual ethanol, repeating if necessary; a fourth wash may be performed if required.

steps.title: Elute DNA into deep‑well plate
steps.instruction: Place the 96‑Well Deep‑Well Plate in the Manifold Bed, position the Vacuum Manifold Collar on top, orient the plate with column headers toward the vacuum port, and place the Binding Plate on the Collar so that its tips are centered over the deep‑well plate wells; add 250 µL of room‑temperature Nuclease‑Free Water to each well of the Binding Plate, incubate for 00:02:00 at room temperature, then apply vacuum until the water passes through; release the vacuum and remove the Wizard SV 96 Binding Plate; optionally transfer the eluates into 1.5 mL tubes; gently detach the Manifold Collar while keeping the Deep‑Well Plate aligned, and if droplets are visible on the upper edge of the wells, tap the plate on the bench to let them settle.

steps.title: Store extracted DNA
steps.instruction: DNA is ready for immediate use or can be stored sealed in the plate at 4 °C for a few days, at –20 °C for a few weeks, or at –70 °C for long‑term storage; seal the plate tightly with a plate sealer before storage.
